title: Independent lazy branches release out of order
reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.intent: Independent lazy branches release out of order
contract.failure_hypothesis: One pending module evaluation can globally block a different module or release the wrong branch.
preconditions: Fresh owned supervisor root; exact candidate/profile/pins; isolated private disposable runtime under reviewed external limits.
Real Loader positive control succeeds; all positive graph mains are callable before any lazy evaluation starts.
Any claimed held overlap must show unique actual receiver invocation IDs and matching finite gates.
trace: Start left and right imports in one graph.
Witness both IDs and both gates.
Release right; assert left still pending; release left.
contract.stress: Two independent module evaluation promises and reverse release order.
contract.oracle: Right resolves right; left remains active without left-ready; then left resolves left.
contract.cleanup: Observe startup of every opened worker; close scope; reject remaining owned module gates; settle complete setup/trace tasks and every tracked RPC; only then dispose entries/workers. Any unresolved stop/drain is BLOCKED and external owned teardown is mandatory.
contract.overlap: same-request overlap of two actual loaded-worker invocations
contract.qualification: characterization-candidate; no universal Cloudflare cache/scheduling guarantee; no promotion
